description_en: Creates a one-time virus scan task that is immediately executed
description_zh: 创建病毒扫描一次性任务
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-virus-scan-once-task --selection-key 845de1ec-4b08-42e1-b564-31321e48xxxx --scan-type system --scan-path /var/spool/cron --param additionType_:_SCAN_MEMORY --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirusScanOnceTask

parameters.help_en:
The key that stores the asset information.

You can call the [GetAssetSelectionConfig](~~GetAssetSelectionConfig~~) operation to obtain the key value
parameters.help_zh:
保存资产信息的键值。
您可以调用[GetAssetSelectionConfig](~~GetAssetSelectionConfig~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: selection_key

parameters.help_en:
The type of the virus scan. Valid values:

system: system scan.
user: custom scan
parameters.help_zh:
病毒扫描的扫描类型。取值：
system：系统扫描
user：自定义扫描
parameters.name: scan_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the scan path that is required for a custom scan
parameters.help_zh: 如果是自定义扫描需要传输的扫描路径信息
parameters.name: scan_path

parameters.help_en:
Additional information fields: 
additionType: The type of extended scan
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息字段：
additionType：拓展的扫描类型
parameters.name: param
